originality.rationale: The nearest publicly posted exact variance theorem is explicitly binary (q=2), not an all-nonbinary formula. Wang–Li–Fu 2026 proves maxima of pairwise intersections, which cannot determine the average or variance of a single random deletion-ball cardinality. The new canonical-embedding and return-triple covariance identities give a separate closed result for every q>=3. Targeted published-finding corpus and literature searches identified no stronger implication; unindexed equivalent statements remain a genuine risk.
